items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I had these two boys on trumpet and I had Leroy and I had the other little fella on piano.

ctx.x: At Scoop County, they got on.

Yeah. And that, we went on from there and there. Never did catch us in no violation or nothing. You know what I mean? We went along. And we did, we did pretty good. Because I had a lot of connections from one job to the other. That's how I'm going to work through right now. I got a big job coming up, I'm going to let you know, because I want you and him to come. I wanted to get you out to dance. I had you boys up there at the Union Hall up there that night. And I played for the shrines from all over the world it…
